## Lab 6: The Internet of Things and Serial Peripheral Interface

In this lab, we made an IOT device that can control an LED and read temperature from an SPI sensor. The IOT website also has the option to change the resolution, which changes the sensor read time and how precise we can get.

Spent a total of 19 hours

### SPI Transaction Logic Trace

![Lab6 Website](images\Lab6website.png)

![Lab6 Oscilloscope logic analyser](images\Lab6Osctrace.jpeg)

A hex value of 19 is equal to 16 + 9, which is 25C, this matches the value we see in the website.
